verdict.rationale: RevenueCat is a subscription/monetization backend platform, not an AI agent or assistant that a user interacts with and extends via plugged-in MCP servers. The evidence shows RevenueCat ships its OWN MCP server (revenuecat-docs-9) so that external AI assistants can call RevenueCat's tools — this is the server role, the opposite of the client-side 'plug servers into this product' story, so the axis is a category mismatch here.
